court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. M. Ashwin Kumar for M/s. Sarvabhauman Associates
prayer: PRAYER: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking for an issuance of a writ of certiorarified mandamus to call for the records of the 2nd respondent in his order dated 23.11.2011 in Na.Ka. No. 1407/11/A3 and quash the same and forbear the 2nd respondent from entertaining any future application/petition regarding the payment of any outgoings in respect of the premises bearing No. Na.Ka. No. 1407/11/A3.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the writ petition. He has also made an endorsement to that effect in the court bundle. In view of the endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
